title: STORE tip 1. Auto Fitting
content: After purchasing items from the STORE, you can easily simulate the garments you purchased on your avatar. Dress your custom avatars of various body shapes in clothing items purchased from the STORE! **1\. Purchasing items from the STORE.** 1.1 Purchase items from the STORE on our website. 1.2 Purchase items from the STORE in-software. **2\. Prepare your avatar for Auto Fitting.** 2.1 Create a Fitting Suit for your custom avatar 2.2 Check that there is Fitting Suit data for garments you purchased from the STORE. **3\. Put garments on your avatar easily by using the Auto Fitting feature.** Please refer to the Auto Fitting manual for more details on how to use this feature. title: Can I use Marvelous Designer for physical garment production?
content: Marvelous Designer is generally used in the video production or the game industries to create virtual garments and props, which means that Marvelous designer does not offer several functions that are essential in physical garment production. (e.g. to import/export DXF, to print out the paper patterns). If you are looking for a software to help you with proceeding the physical garment, we would like to introduce you to our sister software 'CLO 3D.' Visit [www.clo3d.com](http://www.clo3d.com) or contact us at [sales@clo3d.com](mailto:sales@clo3d.com)
content_description: Discover how CLO 3D can enhance your physical garment production needs with features not available in Marvelous Designer.

title: Can I make Bags, Interior Props, or Shoes, etc?
content: Yes, you can create any fabric items through Marvelous Designer. You might need some kind of assets or dummies where the flat patterns could sit within the 3D window while simulation. (e.g. Bag Frames, Bed Frames, etc.) For more tutorials, visit our official Youtube channel. Bag tutorial: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xPENO3REhjk> Interior fabric tutorial: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rnJ1vYhyQ7o&list=PLYQUdblF9eDWMHOfEoiB7uQt8LYB0g8bN](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rnJ1vYhyQ7o&list=PLYQUdblF9eDWMHOfEoiB7uQt8LYB0g8bN) <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gokn1Elo6co> Shoes tutorial: [https://youtube.com/watch?v=AvBmQ4w04_8&feature=share](https://youtube.com/watch?v=AvBmQ4w04_8&feature=share) [https://youtube.com/watch?v=yPsToQ4naFc&feature=share](https://youtube.com/watch?v=yPsToQ4naFc&feature=share)
content_description: Discover how to create stunning fabric items in Marvelous Designer with essential assets and step-by-step tutorials available on our official YouTube channel.

title: Are there any assets that I can use beyond the library?
content: Yes, you can easily find those assets from Connect, one of our family sites. Connect is a sort of community that you can either upload the items you create or download the items created from other users. ### How to get to the Connect store throughout Marvelous Designer On the top left corner of the software, you can find the 'Store' tab, where you can not only have previews of the items from the Connect store but also purchase them. ### Visiting the Connect website Connect website: <https://connect.clo-set.com/> Find the Store tab within the Connect web to download various items such as fabrics, avatars, and garments, either for free or with a fee. Also, you can open your own designer shop by uploading any items created by yourself.
content_description: Discover and engage with the Connect community to upload and download creative assets for Marvelous Designer, including fabrics, avatars, and garments, through our user-friendly store interface.

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### Compatible File Format File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, also in a addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | .sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive overview of compatible file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, including details on supported file types and their specific functionalities.

title: I just purchased license update to the latest version but Marvelous Designer won't let me login.
content: If you see the message "The license is already in use by another computer. Please deactivate the license on the other computer and try logging in again", please deactivate license from old version and try to login again. If this does not work, please contact our support team by [contact us](https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact)
content_description: This page provides guidance for users encountering a license conflict message, including steps for deactivation and support contact information.

title: Can I receive my invoice?
content: **Question** Can I receive my invoice? **Answer** Yes, you can check and print out your invoice from the Marvelous Designer website. For Personal users: 1. Go to your [License page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license) and click the "[Order History](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license/history)" button. 2. Click the "Invoice" button according to your subscription. 3. Click the "View" button to download your invoice. For Enterprise users: 1. Login with your Company ID. 2. Put your cursor over the profile icon and click the "[License Account Admin](https://marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole)" button. 3. Click the "[Invoice](https://marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole/invoice)" button. 4. Click the file button below to download your invoice.
content_description: Find out how to easily access and print your invoice from the Marvelous Designer website, whether you're a Personal or Enterprise user.

title: What is the difference between Personal and Enterprise License?
content: There is a distinction based on the user's status. All users must comply with the "[Terms of Service](https://marvelousdesigner.com/terms)." Freelancers are allowed to use personal licenses, but all other companies (studios, game companies, research companies, etc.) must purchase enterprise licenses. If a corporate entity purchases personal licenses, access to the purchased Marvelous Designer license may be restricted or terminated without prior notice. If a personal license is purchased using a company's credit card or company email address, it may be considered as a purchase by a corporate customer.
content_description: This webpage outlines the licensing requirements for users of Marvelous Designer, distinguishing between freelancers and corporate entities to ensure compliance with our Terms of Service.

title: How can I get a trial version of Marvelous Designer?
content: ## **For personal users:** Yes, we provide a 14-days free trial. Check our **[Trial page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing/trial)** for more information. * The trial is available for a one-time use. * When the trial expires, your monthly subscription will be automatically charged. If you do not wish to proceed with the subscription payment, please cancel it on the [license page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). ## **For Enterprise users:** Please send the request through [sales@marvelousdesigner.com](https://sales@marvelousdesigner.com). A representative will respond within 2-3 business days.
content_description: Discover our 14-day free trial for personal users and enterprise inquiries to explore the features of Marvelous Designer, with easy options to manage your subscription.

title: There is another similar software called CLO, what is the difference?
content: We have two different products called Marvelous Designer and CLO that have been specifically designed for the entertainment and fashion industries, respectively. While similar, CLO is equipped with additional features that are essential to fashion designers including avatar size adjustability and support for DXF-AAMA (drawing) files. On the other hand, Marvelous Designer including UV editor, sculpt mode Other features unique to CLO are: The ability to measure the avatar as a tailor would, tech pack (specifications) feature, diverse stitching visuals, and advanced CAD features. To learn more about CLO, please visit [www.clo3d.com](https://www.clo3d.com/)
content_description: Discover the unique features of our specialized products, Marvelous Designer for the entertainment industry and CLO for fashion design, to find the perfect fit for your creative needs.
